state: The subject is a ledger reorganization for Can testing: 143 stable tasks, no users to support through legacy compatibility. This turn permits changes to planning artifacts and running only two ledger validators. Source authoring must wait for accepted start_after inputs; final completion must additionally satisfy accept_after. Individual migration rows have independent progress rules, and their explicit gates remain minimum requirements for whichever facets they retain. Trust is partitioned into R, N, S, A and C; C never approves itself or updates the judging reference. The concurrency ceiling allows three disjoint implementers beside an integrator/reviewer. That fourth role owns shared compiler/catalogue files, global formatting, serialized commits, caller activation and old-harness deletion. Run/case/verification/build resources each admit only one live occupant, with phase order enforced. Recent review units of 1600–2700 lines impede integration flow. Recorded controls for some promised external mechanisms instead exercise in-memory doubles; the P13 host record also concedes unenforced memory above declared peaks and temporary-data overshoot bounded by disk availability. Neither is sufficient qualification. Transitive prerequisite duplicates occur throughout the graph, but pruning such edges leaves the same partial order. Required host guarantees remain unresolved and required measurements remain deferred, so total completion cannot be forecast as a finite date. Choose how the unchanged acceptance contracts should govern parallel preparation and review.

lane_policy.instructions: Select the most suitable parallel-work plan given the prerequisite semantics and authority limits described above.

criteria.scoped_slices: Use parent-preserving decomposition: after existing start gates pass, separate path-owned authoring, control and receipt increments for bounded review. Count only joined parent acceptance in the143-task total. Reassign free workers to eligible paths, keep promotion serial, and reuse one compatible build while retaining each scope receipt.
criteria.early_parent_credit: Award completion for partial simulated behavior and defer originally promised adapter or acceptance work into later tasks. Use that early completion to unlock the graph.
criteria.whole_task_batches: Keep the present task-sized review units and permanently allocated queues, obeying all gates while accepting idle capacity whenever a lane reaches a blocked parent.
